thesis: MANH is a clean uptrend holding up against a risk-off tape: price is above its 20-, 50- and 200-day averages, and a post-earnings gap-up on heavy volume has held. Fundamentals back the move, with revenue growth accelerating for three straight quarters, high quality, strong margins, and low dilution risk. The setup is a pullback entry (247-252) with a defined stop below the swing low, so risk is controlled. The case is limited by a rich valuation, extension near the 52-week high, a modest reward/risk of about 1.2, and a risk-off regime, so this is a measured long, not a high-conviction one.
